reproduction: In the first draft of run-native-pi-agent.ps1, $relayState was computed on Host from $env:USERPROFILE and then passed as if it were a Guest path.
observation: On this Host it would resolve under the Administrator profile, while pi-bansos resolves its relay state under the Guest user's homedir (.pi\agent); the error was caught by code review before the new Agent run was launched.
expected: All Guest paths must be created/resolved inside the Guest script block and the delivered files/versions must be verified before launch.
impact: If not corrected, the native Agent would either write relay state to the wrong Guest path or fail to enable the Host model relay, repeating the earlier provider-boundary failure.
evidence: Initial run-native-pi-agent.ps1 draft and current Host/Guest user-profile distinction.
minimal_change: Resolve relay state with Guest $env:USERPROFILE inside Invoke-Command; hash-check the delivered task/prompt and verify native Pi/plugin/workspace before Start-Process.
rollback: Revert the delivery-verification block and remove only the per-run relay state after cleanup.
verification: delivery-verification.json with matching hashes, native Pi/plugin versions, and relay_state_path under Guest profile before Agent launch.
unresolved_risk: The model upstream may still fail after correct delivery; that must be classified separately from delivery.
